summary_step: 1. Reads the current estimate trend direction from the trend detector.
2. Returns congesting due to estimate when the estimate trend is downward.
3. Returns congesting due to loss when the NACK tracker is triggered.
4. Returns clearing when the estimate trend is upward.
5. Returns inconclusive with no reason when no signal is decisive.
